`workflow_dispatch` needs a separate owner decision for the exact candidate. No secrets, deployment, LIVE or production database.

## What it tests
Candidate `c867dc0de12f4f3fbe544c1172a95b5e6176d4cb` (tree `ae78a4cd5cd584cd626914422031b2902b6841db`, parent = published handoff
`ce90f3a8…`, code base = integrated merge `3be8259e…` of main `fc98aae5…` + F02 `1d89ecd3…`). It differs from `3be8259` by exactly two
files (`candidate-allowed-paths.txt`): the handoff note and the new test-only script
`scripts/fin-sdo-1-isolated-evidence-gaps-verify.ts` (FIN1-05, FIN1-23).

Chain: PostgreSQL 16 service container → numbered migrations **001–037** (`npm run db:migrate`, ledger asserted sequential, zero `fin_*` tables yet)
→ UNNUMBERED FIN SQL (loaded by the native scripts, never as a numbered migration) → real HTTP (Nest on loopback) through the **restricted FIN LOGIN**.

| Order | check | notes |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | identity (before any candidate code) | SHA, tree, parents, full history, clean tree, diff-vs-base allowlist, 37 migrations, none FIN-named, FIN SQL blob `2c5e24e5…` |
| 1 | typecheck, build, unit | FIN unit (+access matrix), R01 permissions, R03a/b/d |
| 2 | postgres-identity, migrate-001-037, migration-ledger | PG 16.x, `fin_sdo_test`, loopback only |
| 3 | native-pg, -service, -http, -protected, -sec01-f01 | unchanged F02-era scripts, now on 001–037 |
| 4 | native-evidence-gaps | FIN1-05, FIN1-23 (+ DEC-01 and scope guards) |
| 5 | reviewer-negative-f02 | reviewer-owned probe from `main`, unchanged |

Dependent checks are recorded `NOT_RUN` (never silently skipped) when their prerequisite fails. Every check keeps raw stdout/stderr and an `.exit` file;
`teardown.txt` records container log capture and stop; `SHA256SUMS` seals all files; `RESULT.md` is generated by `seal.sh`.

## Reviewer steps
1. Read this branch from GitHub at the exact SHA; confirm `candidate.env`, the workflow `ref:`, the confirmation string and `candidate-allowed-paths.txt` agree.
2. Re-derive the candidate diff (`git diff 3be8259 c867dc0`) = two files. Confirm no workflow/infra/product-source change.
3. After an owner-authorized run: download the artifact, verify `SHA256SUMS`, `git-identity.txt` equals the pins, every `*.exit` is `0`, `checks.tsv` has no `FAIL`/`NOT_RUN`,
   `teardown.txt` exit codes are `0`, and `run-identity.txt` binds run id / attempt 1 / actor.
4. Run your own negative probes; adjudicate FIN1-05/FIN1-23 against the raw logs (grep `FIN1-05`, `FIN1-23`), including the executor's mutation evidence in the handoff.

## Local reproduction (no GitHub, disposable loopback PG16 only)
`DATABASE_URL=postgres://…@127.0.0.1:<port>/fin_sdo_test FIN_SDO_ISOLATED_CONFIRM=YES ./run-checks.sh <core> <harness> <evidence_dir>`; the script refuses any other URL.
PostgreSQL roles are cluster-global: use a fresh cluster (CI does) or drop `fin_sdo_*` roles first.
